name: tenant
description: Multi-tenant operations: create, suspend, upgrade and destroy tenants, plus per-tenant usage metering and billing reports.
author: nself
notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin. It provides TWO commands, `nself tenant` and `nself billing`, declared in cliCommands; the installer publishes nself-tenant and nself-billing into ~/.nself/plugins/bin/. Extracted from the CLI core under CLI-R11. internal/tenant stays in the CLI as well, because `nself db` uses it. Project settings come from the environment: nself resolves the .env cascade and passes in every variable listed in envVars, so this plugin never re-implements the cascade.

cliCommands.name: tenant
cliCommands.description: Create, list, suspend, upgrade and destroy tenants

cliCommands.name: billing
cliCommands.description: Per-tenant usage metering, invoices and billing reports
